svg.title: Animated FastWAM v4 Spatial-Temporal Memory
svg.desc: A ten-second loop showing video and executed action history becoming layer-aligned key-value memory, future action queries reading the cache, and executed controls updating the online history.

g.text: History becomes read-only memory; future actions remain the denoising stream
actual controls only · never predicted-but-unexecuted chunks

svg.text: K/V aligned to each MoT layer
A(t:t+31) is the only evolving stream
WHAT CHANGES INSIDE EACH ACTION LAYER?
Execute → append actual action + next observation → slide window
the next replan rebuilds a fresh layer-aligned condition cache
Current v4 defaults: 5 visual samples · 20 executed actions · 32-step future action chunk.
Spatial memory within frames · temporal memory across the executed trajectory
